question: Basanti Devi Bisht, the famous singer from Uttarakhand, is known for singing which type of folk songs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jagar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **well-known folk singer** from **Uttarakhand** is **Basanti Devi Bisht.**
 
• She gained notoriety for being the** first female performer** of Uttarakhand's **Jagar folk style.**
 
• The Jagar form of singing is a **way of invoking deities.**
 
• The song is often sung by **men,** but Basanti Bisht **broke the mold **and is now a well-known singer.
 
• In** 2017**, she received the **Padma Shri honor.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Chhura:**

 
 
• Chhura of **Uttarakhand** is a beautifully written and widely popular** folk song for shepherds.**
 
 
 
• **Bajuband:**
 
 
• It is also known as **armband** is acknowledged to grace the bride with a **sense of pride and confidence.**
 
 
 
• **Choopati:**
 
 
• Chhopati of **Uttarakhand** is one of the **finest romantic folk songs sung by men and women.**
